framework.note: 这是当前 Unity 宿主的资源与框架状态；Editor 的 DLL 使用编译程序集，不代表手机 HybridCLR 注入通过

checks: 布阵空地横滑保持固定机位与选中状态通过
开局零单位（全靠老虎机招募）与禁止空阵开战通过
招募动画落地前隐藏图标、抵达候补槽瞬间显现通过
双击候补军团卡片自动寻位上场通过
tap即选中、无按钮面板、拖出白框吸附点A(剪影预览)通过
竖屏左边缘部署、取消和重新命中通过
拖动场上单位到候补区直接召回通过
右侧敌军入场可见，暂停锁住相机平移与朝向通过
真实战斗、固定移速A*导航、暂停/伤害统计及战中拒绝布阵通过
从零单位起手完整10波横向远征获胜通过
单兵阵亡团灭判负及重开归零通过
UI换肤sprite完整、按钮边界/触屏高度/无重叠及Console零报错通过

extensions.description: Inspect the existing FairyGUI runtime tree and controllers; never creates GRoot or UI.
extensions.unavailableReason: FairyGUI is not loaded in this Editor.

operations.name: tree
operations.description: Read runtime UI nodes by child-index path (root is empty, e.g. 0/2). Depth 0..6; limit 1..200. Duplicate names are unambiguous. Only realized virtual-list children are reported.

operations.name: controllers
operations.description: Read controller names, selected pages and indices at uiPath.

extensions.description: 符阵军团英雄配表、羁绊、法力技能、NavMeshAgent战斗和第一关十波；所有操作调用玩家共用规则。

operations.name: get_state
operations.description: 读取横向远征阶段、白色布阵框边界、归队状态、推进里程、存活军团、狂暴状态、人口上限与经验、招募次数/保底/十字中奖线、军团/敌人(含homeX/homeZ/facingYaw/turnSpeed/moveSpeed/canMerge)、技能实例(impactAt/timingMode/projectileSpeed)、每单位法力/星级技能/独立冷却/状态/属性、羁绊、出怪小波、伤害统计（按英雄归属、本波及整局实际扣血）、首领预警、胜负与事件

operations.name: get_view
operations.description: 读取UI主题/缺失素材、全局悬浮Tip(红/金)、候补拖回热区、按钮坐标与宽高、单位/阵位坐标、固定朝向机位模式、实际基础偏航(cameraYaw)、相机X及前移边界、道路入口、单位模型与动作/播放时间、技能时间轴统计与active.visualImpactAt、材质Shader支持及无限横向滚动场景状态；坐标左下原点0到1

operations.name: get_navigation
operations.description: 只读查询原生NavMesh路径、阻挡原因、FSM目标、实际速度和导航适配层累计CPU耗时；unitId可选，不推进时间

operations.name: get_events
operations.description: 读取sequence之后的实际规则事件；重复轮询不推进时间。缓存保留最近600条，返回oldestSequence供识别缺口

operations.name: get_definitions
operations.description: 查看英雄、怪物、招募池、羁绊、波次表和规则版本；不改变状态

operations.name: restart
operations.description: 玩家重开同样调用，清空本局；seed为可复现随机种子，默认173

operations.name: spin
operations.description: 正常转盘：每波3次，援军令后4次，十字中线（中横排与中竖排）三同出兵，十字双连出2兵；两次空转后下次保底；从中奖职业随机发放英雄；凑齐三名同名同星英雄自动合成升星

operations.name: deploy
operations.description: 在整体白色布阵框内自由部署或替换单位；传世界坐标 x/z 时超出白框自动夹紧到最近合法点 A；也支持参考 lane/row(0..2)；准备阶段限定，受人口上限(6→9)约束

operations.name: recall
operations.description: 召回候补（玩家通过将场上单位拖入候补区触发）；至少保留一名上阵、候补容量6

operations.name: recycle
operations.description: 遣散候补，不能直接删除上阵兵；仅用于处理容量，无材料收益

operations.name: merge
operations.description: 手动请求合成三个同名同星英雄（正常招募会自动合成）；最高3星

operations.name: start_wave
operations.description: 正常开战，未用次数放弃；暂存未处理会拒绝。双方以0法力开始，小波按表中时间入场。全军原生NavMeshAgent导航、攻击落点预占与阻挡等待，规则状态机驱动交锋

operations.name: next_wave
operations.description: 仅波后进入下一波，全员满血恢复推进下一段、刷新次数，不能跳过奖励或战斗

operations.name: choose_reward
operations.description: 第4/8波后选择尚未持有的局内强化；援军令不可叠加

operations.name: pause
operations.description: 正常暂停或继续，仅战斗阶段

operations.name: set_speed
operations.description: 玩家同款1/2倍速度；不是调试跳帧或直接结算

operations.name: pointer
operations.description: 共用触屏/鼠标入口：begin/move/end/cancel；用于验证tap即选中、点布阵框外空地取消选中、滑空地不改变机位、拖拽吸附最近点A、拖回候补召回、双击候补上场与取消；坐标左下0到1

operations.name: capture_view
operations.description: 保存实际场景和HUD合成渲染，540x960；编辑器截图不是手机截图

operations.name: profile_capture
operations.description: 编辑器诊断：start 解除限帧和垂直同步并记录逐帧 CPU/GC，stop 保存并恢复，status 只读状态；不修改战斗规则

operations.name: performance
operations.description: 最近240帧的帧间隔、尺寸和平台；编辑器数据不得���为手机帧率

extensions.description: Read Spine assets, animation tracks and sampled bone positions. Does not initialize, advance or modify skeletons.
extensions.unavailableReason: Spine runtime is not loaded in this Editor.

operations.name: inspect
operations.description: Read initialized skeleton, skin, flip/scale, tracks and facing against an optional cameraInstanceId. Target the exact component GameObject.

operations.name: catalog
operations.description: Page animations, skins, slots, bones or event definitions from initialized skeleton data; assetPath may target a SkeletonDataAsset without a scene object.

operations.name: bones
operations.description: Page current bone local/skeleton/world positions; optional boneName selects an exact bone. No transform-name fallback.

extensions.description: Start a scoped EditMode test run and poll its result. Tests may modify the project; no automatic replay after reload.

operations.name: run
operations.description: Queue EditMode tests from one exact assemblyName, optionally one exact testName. Returns runId immediately. Requires allowWrite=true. Cancellation is not supported by the bundled TestRunner API.

operations.name: status
operations.description: Read the latest test run, optionally verifying its runId. Reload interrupts observation and reports interrupted rather than success.
